base_template.base_concept: Mystical cephalopod intelligences with bioluminescent wonder

morphology.facial_features: expressive alien eyes, spiritual depth, cosmic swirls

base_template.prompt_template:
3D bioship design: {ship_name}
Species Origin: Syl'Nar (cephalopod mystics)
Bioluminescence Color: {bioluminescence_color}
Translucency Level: {translucency_level}%
Spiritual Alignment: {spiritual_alignment}
Tentacle Complexity: {tentacle_complexity}%

Specifications:
- Organic flowing bio-form hull, {ship_length}m
- Graceful asymmetric tentacle-like structures
- Pulsing bioluminescent propulsion systems
- Harmonic resonance disruption weapons
- Semi-transparent membrane hull with internal luminescence
- Cosmic-scale sensory observation arrays

Visual Style: Transcendent spirituality in living form. Bioluminescent wonder and cosmic empathy.
Material Language: Flowing bio-membranes with pulsing luminescent patterns in cyan and pink.
Aesthetic Philosophy: Form flows with grace and spiritual purpose. Every surface resonates with cosmic connection.
Purpose: Diplomatic explorer, spiritual guide, cosmic seeker vessel

enhancement_history.prompt_modification: Apply 60% natural aging with 40% battle damage and bio-growth patina formation
